title: Get Creative Features Response
description: Response payload for the get_creative_features task. Exactly one shape is returned: terminal success with results and a provider evaluation identity, terminal error, or a submitted acknowledgement carrying both the pollable task identity and the provider evaluation identity.

evaluation_id.description: Optional provider evaluation identity when failure occurred after the evaluation was accepted. When present, it is the same value returned on the submitted acknowledgement.

oneOf.title: GetCreativeFeaturesSubmitted
oneOf.description: Async acknowledgement returned after the provider accepts an evaluation but cannot complete it within the response window. Exact request replays return this original acknowledgement with replayed: true, the same task_id, and the same evaluation_id. The caller polls get_task_status using task_id; terminal results carry the same evaluation_id.

status.description: Task-level status literal that discriminates this acknowledgement from terminal success and error responses.

task_id.description: AdCP task handle used to poll get_task_status or correlate terminal webhook delivery. Distinct from evaluation_id.

evaluation_id.description: Provider-generated identity allocated when the evaluation is accepted. The terminal result MUST carry this same value. Distinct from task_id and idempotency_key.

message.description: Optional human-readable explanation of why the evaluation is submitted. Plain text only; callers treat it as untrusted provider input.
